target.title: feat(nodes): add auto-discovered Ollama inference
target.body:
Closes #99228

AI-assisted: Codex. I understand and reviewed the implementation and its node/plugin boundaries.

## What Problem This Solves

Agents connected to desktop or server nodes could not discover and use a fast local model on that node. Using Ollama as the Gateway provider requires direct Gateway network access, while shelling out through node exec has no typed model discovery, capability filtering, or bounded result contract.

## Why This Change Was Made

The bundled Ollama plugin now owns two node-host commands (`ollama.models` and `ollama.chat`) plus a `node_inference` agent tool. It reuses the existing plugin command registry, node invoke policy, and runtime node APIs; Ollama remains loopback-only on the node, with no new core protocol, config, dependency, or remote-provider fallback.

Startup activation is deliberate: node-host command metadata must be registered before a node advertises its capabilities, so lazy Gateway provider discovery cannot expose these commands. Ollama API requests remain demand-driven.

Discovery positively verifies completion capability, excludes cloud and embedding-only rows, and ranks loaded models first. Runs validate one exact local model, bound prompts/output/timeouts/error bodies, report usage/timings, and surface token-limit truncation as an error.

## User Impact

Users can keep small helper tasks on a paired node: start Ollama and the OpenClaw node host, approve the advertised commands, then ask an agent to discover and run an installed model. The path is available on macOS, Linux, and Windows node hosts and stays subject to normal node pairing and command policy.

## Evidence

- Real final-source E2E: built Gateway -> paired node host -> local Ollama `qwen3:0.6b`; `node_inference` returned exact `NODE_LOCAL_OK` (23 prompt tokens, 4 completion tokens, 1.58s total), then discovery ranked it first with `loaded: true`. Cloud and embedding-only models were absent.
- Focused tests: `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/ollama/src/node-inference.test.ts extensions/ollama/src/provider-models.test.ts extensions/ollama/src/provider-models.ssrf.test.ts extensions/ollama/index.test.ts src/plugins/contracts/plugin-tool-contracts.test.ts src/plugins/bundled-plugin-metadata.test.ts` (122 tests, 3 shards).
- Build: `pnpm build`.
- Docs: `pnpm format:docs:check`, `pnpm docs:map:check`, `pnpm docs:check-mdx`, and `pnpm docs:check-links` (5,545 links, 0 broken).
- Review: `.agents/skills/autoreview/scripts/autoreview --mode local` returned clean after all accepted findings were fixed.
- Remote changed-surface check: Blacksmith Testbox `tbx_01kwj933sna0besx7tnjhzb0c7` (`blue-shrimp`), exit 0; [delegated Actions run](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/28620275629). Covered core/extension test types, all core and extension lint shards, database-first and sidecar guards, and import-cycle analysis.
